summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I found before proposing anything (read-only audit) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` (fetch with `credentials: "include"`) → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` auth check → `watchlists` table (`user_id` keyed, not nullable) → `db/auth.ts` session/login logic. Result: **the server-side and DB-side logic all check out as correct.** Every watchlist route filters strictly by `user_id`, `user_id` is stable across logins (only the session token rotates), there's no anonymous/local-storage fallb
